messages.subject: Inventory allocation procedure for our releases
messages.body:
Hi Elaine,

Could we use the same allocation report for our future releases? Please keep our line numbers and item codes unchanged. Let me know if you need a completed example from our previous orders.

Best,
Alex Chen
Harbor Instruments

messages.subject: PO 1004 - availability check
messages.body:
Hi Elaine,

Please check the attached release against your latest stock and send us the allocation report. There are two lines for 0007; please allocate stock in the order shown rather than treating them as separate stock balances. We will confirm delivery after reviewing the shortage.

Many thanks,
Alex
